title: parley participant registry
description: participants.json: who is in the parley. Exactly one participant has role chair, and the chair is human (enforced by tools/validate.py, not expressible here).

model.description: Model string as the harness reports it. Required for kind model.

harness.description: How this participant is invoked: claude-code, codex-cli, llama-server, human, dispatch, ... Free-form; the dispatcher keys on it.

capabilities.description: Defined values: repo (has a worktree; can read code and the log directly), shell, web. Others are free-form.

latency.description: Sets the dispatcher's per-turn wait and how the projection is budgeted. human: no deadline.

worktree.description: Path of this participant's git worktree, relative to the chair's checkout.

branch.description: Branch this participant commits to; convention parley/<id>.

context_budget.description: Approximate token budget for one projection. Participants with a budget receive summarized projections.

inline_diff_lines.description: Diffs at or under this many lines are inlined in this participant's projection; larger ones are referenced.

command.description: Harness knob: executable (or argv prefix) that invokes this participant. Defaults: claude, codex. For harness `command`, the program that reads a projection on stdin and prints records.

harness_args.description: Harness knob: extra arguments appended to the invocation (permissions, sandbox, model flags).

session.description: Harness knob: resume the participant's CLI session between turns (delta projections) or start fresh each turn (full-log projections).

timeout_s.description: Harness knob: per-turn wall-clock limit; overrides the latency-class default.
